title: The power gate is a step function on final damage
body: Team power ÷ the stage's recommended power picks a bracket; the bracket multiplies final damage, last in crumblehub's formula (after defence, element, boss damage, crit).

title: No interpolation between steps
body: 39.9% of recommended power fights at 15%, 40.0% at 35%. '35% 단' means pushing at 40–59% of recommended power; '15%' at 20–39%.

title: What the gate does not touch
body: Only your team's damage is cut: boss damage is unchanged, and your stats keep counting past the 120% cap. PvP's correction is fixed at 100%.

title: The same table gates other content
body: The bracket table also gates the daily dungeons, the Implant Tower and the Dimensional Rift.

title: Team power is the formation's displayed power, and it can be padded
body: The gate reads formation-screen power: gear, sugar runes, plates, guild and pets. Leaving a guild dropped one player from 35% to 15%.

title: How pushers pad power
body: Gear rolled 'purely for power' (뻥투), crit-resist lines (a cape: 3.99M with one, 2.82M without) and SSR rune lines kept until the Rift (+3–4M each).

title: Just short is a full bracket down
body: 0.6M short of the 40% line (971.8M against 972.5M at 271-11) fought at 15%.

title: Accuracy and focus are a second gate per stage
body: Each stage has an accuracy requirement (enemy evasion) and a focus one (enemy resistance). At it, attacks hit 100% and debuffs land as listed; below, they miss.

title: Accuracy caps, focus keeps climbing
body: Game data 1.4.002: accuracy stops rising at 1,203.5 from about chapter 248 to 328-30; focus keeps rising to 1,161.5 at 328-30.

title: What missing accuracy costs
body: About 10% more misses per 100 accuracy short, per one poster; 950 accuracy hit about 79% at 270-18 before the easing.

title: How much accuracy the pushers actually run
body: Post-easing, 900 accuracy is called enough to 328; ND러너 runs 900–1,000 on stages and 1,000+ past 300. 1,300 is wasted.

title: Before the easing, accuracy was tight
body: 35% pushers wanted 1,000–1,100+ accuracy; dropping from 1,150 to 930 broke clears around chapter 250.

title: Focus is for debuffers; 15% and the Rift need more
body: Focus matters for Dark Choco and Scorpion's shred ('drop Dark Choco's focus and it's an empty can'). At 15% and in the Rift every miss costs more.

title: The 2026-09-23 easing lowered recommended power and enemy stats
body: Update 1.4.002 cut recommended power, enemy ATK and HP from almost nothing at 169-1 to about 30% at 248-30 (2.00G → 1.40G) and 36% at 328-30 (15.61G → 10.00G).

title: Accuracy requirements didn't change
body: 248-30 stayed at 1,203 accuracy. One player's 55% reach still moved from chapter 257 to 273 overnight.

title: Bosses rebalanced (169-1 to 248-30)
body: Cool Mint, Rowdy Biker, Rowdy Truck, GingerCraven, Cream Eagle, Tainted Ent, Redberry Assassin, Choco Werehound Princess.

title: Chapters cycle through eight zones with fixed boss slots
body: Chapter c is zone ((c − 1) mod 8) + 1: grassland, beach, ruined city, desert, mushroom zone, plaza, lava zone, snowfield. Layouts repeat from chapter 169.

title: The -30 boss per zone
body: Cool Mint: grassland, beach, plaza. GingerCraven (비겁한 쿠키): ruined city, snowfield. Ginkgoblin Stormer: desert. Tainted Ent: mushroom zone. Magma Sugar Waffle Lizard: lava zone.

title: The -10 and -20 bosses
body: Ruined city: three Rowdy Bikers (-10), the Rowdy Truck (-20). Plaza: ten Redberry Assassins (-10), Choco Werehound Princess (망치공주, -20). The rest are mob stages, several with ten enemies.

title: GingerCraven (비겁이) is the wall at every bracket
body: The ruined-city and snowfield -30 boss flees, fears the team and outlasts low damage: where a bracket stops working ('비겁이 컷').

title: Before the easing: 35% at best
body: GingerCraven needed 35% at best; many pushers took it at 55% with padded power.

title: At 15%, GingerCraven fails
body: 256-30 at 980M left it at 41% after an hour; another pusher removed about 20% of its HP at 15%, then cleared first try at 35%.

title: Bring a dedicated GingerCraven deck
body: Scorpion, Lime or Tiger Lily, Ion, and damage-reduction perks and pets.

title: When 35% keeps failing, climb to 55%
body: Swap filler support for power (GingerBright → Pinot Noir, Grapevine → Brightseeker) to reach 55%; clear within about 20 tries, not hours at 35%.

title: Launch bosses: bring Panda Dumpling
body: Panda Dumpling (판다만두) as third pet, even at low level, for Lift RES and HP. Launchers: Cool Mint, Werehound Princess, Tainted Ent, King Choco Drop.

title: Redberry Assassin and the truck need hands
body: Redberry packs wipe and scatter: swap two melee for Jungle Warrior or Tiger Lily and Rye and lure them to the 6 o'clock stairs, or go area rapid-fire.

title: Rowdy Truck: kite, then auto
body: Kite it in circles at 7 or 9 o'clock until the team's first heal (about 26 s in), then leave it to auto.

title: Where 15% works and where it doesn't
body: 15% clears are mob stages and weak bosses: 271-11 (Lava Waffle Lizard pack) at 971.8M; 301-27 and 301-28 at 2.05G by hand on an all-power preset.

title: Walls at 15%
body: The -30 bosses, bikers, truck, eagle and Redberry packs are walls at 15%; GingerCraven at 15% is 'nearly impossible'.

title: An unshown 15% claim
body: 328-30 at 'just over 3G' with Bari 9★ and Cherry Cola 10★: claimed, no screenshot.

title: After the easing, 35% pushes to 328-30
body: Since 2026-09-23, 35% clears to the end: 328-30 GingerCraven at 4.00G, 4.06G and 4.2G; 312-30 at 2.74G; 266-30 Cool Mint on auto at 1.17G.

title: Runs now fail on damage, not survival
body: The 35% line at 328-30 is 4.00G (40% of 10.00G). Tanks and Herb leave the deck for damage and Rockstar.

title: Push, then park at the highest clear
body: Idle rewards follow the stage you park on: push until stuck, park on the highest clear, reinvest, push again.

title: 55% by hand, stop at 35%
body: Guides call about 55% of recommended a realistic manual target and about 35% the point to stop and farm; tryhards push at 35%, mob stages at 15%.

title: Boss auto-summon retries unattended
body: With 자동 소환 예약 on, a deck retries a boss on auto indefinitely; one 264-30 clear came after 30 minutes by hand, then unattended retries.

title: Dimensional Rift: rules
body: Opens at 328-30. Seasonal (season 1: 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-08, levels 1–100; later seasons 101–200) and boss-only: one boss fight per level.

title: Dimensional Rift: recommended power
body: From 10.00G at level 1 to about 1,800G at level 100.

title: Dimensional Rift: 차원의 힘 (Dimensional Energy)
body: A Rift-only stat that fills per minute in the Rift and raises ATK, DEF and HP amplification, crit, accuracy and focus there only.

title: Dimensional Rift: 차원의 힘 inflates power
body: Displayed power grows with it: 4.0G to 8.05G by 차원의 힘 Lv.4; ND러너 showed 22G against about 5G real.

title: Dimensional Rift: rewards
body: Per-level clears (a profile frame at 10; ND러너 names pets at 1 and 20), a 차원의 조각 shop (about 3 a minute), daily and season all-server rankings.

title: Dimensional Rift: the power gate applies
body: Brackets apply against the level's recommended power and the Rift-inflated team power. One poster felt no penalty; four others and the top player say it applies.

title: Dimensional Rift: every level opens with 차원의 힘
body: ND러너: 'treat every Rift level as a 35% fight'; each level becomes clearable once enough 차원의 힘 has stacked.

title: Dimensional Rift: 15% with full shred, except GingerCraven
body: With maximum DEF shred the other bosses fall at 15%; GingerCraven needs 35%.

title: Dimensional Rift: bosses and tech
body: Boss types repeat: level 3 Werehound Princess, 4 Rowdy Truck, 5 and 15 GingerCraven, 6 Cake Hound Pack, 9 three trucks, 100 GingerCraven. Adds come from both sides.

title: Dimensional Rift: top-guild tech
body: Stack Scorpion's poison to 20 and DEF shred to 10; add Dark Choco and Devil against the truck; pull the boss to 7 or 9 o'clock.

title: Dimensional Rift: five tries, then park
body: Give a level about five tries: if 20–30% of its HP comes off, keep trying; else park and level 차원의 힘.

title: Dimensional Rift: buffs and pets
body: The entrance grants a Charge buff; Octo Wasabi (와사비 문어) is the favoured pet; the Rift-only SSR pet 무한바퀴 raises boss damage there.
